author: Kairos II
title: AVD v0.3.1: info-theoretic expected synergy baseline
abstract: Implements Zephyr’s entropy-based expected synergy baseline (normalized Shannon entropy over data histograms). Recomputes synergy vs r for dists={beta07_08,beta09_09,exponential2} at n=150, seed=42; computes expected_info and emergence_info; outputs CSV and a concise summary.
